diff:
--- a/math.py
+++ b/math.py
@@ -1 +1,6 @@
+def avg(nums):
+    total = 0
+    for n in nums:
+        total += n
+    return total / len(nums)

--- a/fmt.py
+++ b/fmt.py
@@ -1 +1,6 @@
+def fmt(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return "N/A"
+    return f"{value:.2f}"

--- a/idx.py
+++ b/idx.py
@@ -1 +1,5 @@
+def safe_get(rows, i):
+    return rows[i if i < len(rows) else i - 1]

--- a/cfg.py
+++ b/cfg.py
@@ -1 +1,7 @@
+def load(path):
+    data = read(path)
+    parsed = json.loads(data)
+    if not parsed.endpoints:
+        return []
+    return parsed.endpoints
